clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto To Propose Two Vice President Candidates To MPR
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto is set to formally submit two vice presidential candidate names to the MPR on November 25.
Verification officials have proposed that candidates must commit to the full selection process and be prohibited from withdrawing.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Secures Rp1,600 Trillion Investment At APEC Summit
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto finalized investment agreements worth Rp1,600 trillion following his participation in the APEC summit.
The summit featured trilateral discussions between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin regarding global security and nuclear limitations.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung Sets 2027 UMP at Rp6.13 Million
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung set the 2027 provincial minimum wage at Rp6.13 million, representing a 7.1 percent increase.
Labor groups, including the KSPI and the Labor Party, rejected the figure as inadequate and are preparing a legal challenge at the PTUN.

clusters.headline: DPR RI Under Scrutiny Following Asset Recovery Law Enactment
aiSummaryBullets: DPR RI official Habiburokhman refuted allegations of procedural violations during the deliberation and approval of the Asset Recovery Law.
The legislation enables the seizure of assets from individuals involved in fraudulent investment schemes and those accused of corruption.

clusters.headline: Bareskrim Polri Raids Residences Linked To Treason Investigation
aiSummaryBullets: Bareskrim Polri searched six residences in Bogor and Tangerang as part of an investigation into alleged treason and illegal wiretapping.
The investigation involves police officers Brigadier General Tedjo Kusumo and Senior Commissioner Iman Imanuddin.

clusters.headline: Mendagri Tito Karnavian Dorong Pemda Pacu Pertumbuhan Ekonomi
aiSummaryBullets: Menteri Dalam Negeri Tito Karnavian menginstruksikan pemerintah daerah untuk mengoptimalkan belanja untuk meningkatkan peredaran uang.
Kebijakan ekonomi daerah didorong untuk berfokus pada investasi, konsumsi masyarakat, serta pengembangan produk unggulan lokal.

clusters.headline: Minister Raja Juli Antoni Rejects Mining in Ujung Kulon Park
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Forestry Raja Juli Antoni confirmed that no mining permits will be issued for the Ujung Kulon National Park area.
West Java Governor Dedi Mulyadi publicly opposed the proposed relocation of Javan rhinos from Ujung Kulon to Alas Purwo National Park.

clusters.headline: Bareskrim Polri Links Illegal Wiretapping Case To Treason Plot
aiSummaryBullets: Bareskrim Polri confirmed that individuals accused of illegal wiretapping are now serving as witnesses in a separate treason investigation.
Concerns have been raised regarding whether the case should be categorized as treason rather than a violation of the Electronic Information and Transactions Law.

clusters.headline: Public Figures Endorse Sufmi Dasco Ahmad For Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Prominent academic and religious figures have identified Sufmi Dasco Ahmad as a suitable candidate for the Vice President role.
Groups supporting the Vice President transition suggest that recent public criticism against Dasco is politically motivated.

clusters.headline: Mahfud MD Raises Legal Concerns Over MPR Vice President Election
aiSummaryBullets: Mahfud MD warned that holding the vice president election on December 9 could be legally invalid without proper candidate submissions.
The MPR has established an ad hoc committee to draft procedures for the election and inauguration of the new vice president.

clusters.headline: Tito Karnavian And Various Institutions Receive National Awards
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian received an award for his contributions to public service improvement and regional inflation control.
Bank bjb earned recognition for its efforts in regional housing financing and economic growth, while Pekanbaru Lestari was honored for green city development.

clusters.headline: Bank Indonesia Raises Benchmark Interest Rate To 6 Percent
aiSummaryBullets: Bank Indonesia increased the benchmark interest rate to 6 percent to address currency depreciation and manage national inflation.
Economic analysts indicate that external factors continue to influence the rupiah's performance despite the recent rate hike.

clusters.headline: Polda Metro Jaya Intensifies Public Safety and Legal Investigations
aiSummaryBullets: Polda Metro Jaya named 11 suspects in connection with six human trafficking and child exploitation cases.
Authorities arrested an individual identified as CAD in an ongoing personal data protection investigation.

clusters.headline: Indonesia U-17 Ends Asian Cup 2027 Qualifiers Unbeaten After Draw
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia U-17 drew 2-2 with Myanmar in their final AFC Asian Cup 2027 qualifying match.
The result allowed Indonesia to conclude the qualifying stage as the undefeated winner of Group A.

clusters.headline: MPR RI Discusses Regional Bond Regulations to Accelerate Development
aiSummaryBullets: The Golkar Party faction at the MPR RI held a symposium to establish a roadmap for regional bonds as an alternative infrastructure financing tool.
Proposed regulations include strict debt service coverage ratio requirements of 2.5 to mitigate default risks for regional governments.

clusters.headline: Two Police Officers Injured After PIK Security Guard Climbs Car
aiSummaryBullets: A security guard climbed onto the hood of a moving police vehicle in the Pantai Indah Kapuk area.
The incident occurred after bystanders shouted allegations of a hit-and-run against the police vehicle.

clusters.headline: Bareskrim Polri Assists NTT Police In Kupang Regent Rape Case
aiSummaryBullets: The investigation into Kupang Regent Yosef Lede has been upgraded to a formal inquiry following allegations of sexual assault against a student.
National Police headquarters are providing assistance to NTT regional police to support the ongoing probe into the incident.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Urges Asean Regional Cooperation Focus
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto advocated for open and fair economic cooperation among APEC member nations during the recent summit.
The Indonesian government is pushing for increased regional collaboration to manage peatlands sustainably and mitigate cross-border haze.

clusters.headline: Antam Gold Prices Decline To Rp2.5 Million Per Gram In Indonesia
aiSummaryBullets: Antam gold prices fell by Rp11,000 to Rp2.5 million per gram on Friday.
Buyback prices for gold also experienced a notable decline of Rp78,000.

clusters.headline: Fire Damages Nineteen Houses In Baduy Luar Settlement Of Banten
aiSummaryBullets: A fire destroyed nineteen residential homes and two rice granaries in the Baduy Luar settlement located in Cipaler, Banten.
Local reports indicate that at least 34 to 44 families have been affected by the blaze in the Desa Kanekes area.
